task.description: Produce EXT-02 test specification artifacts covering webhook subscription APIs and delivery behavior end to end. Create/update test spec content for unit and integration coverage of POST/GET/DELETE subscription endpoints with PLATFORM_ADMIN enforcement, payload/header contract generation, optional HMAC signature behavior, event fan-out to multiple subscriptions, at-least-once retry/backoff semantics (up to 5 attempts), timeout/non-2xx retry triggers, pause-on-5-failures, OBS-06 alert trigger on pause, and OBS-03 auditing for create/delete. Include explicit edge-case tests: 2xx with invalid/non-JSON response body treated as success, and independent retry counters per subscription for the same source event. Ensure traceability from each EXT-02 acceptance criterion and edge case to test IDs/layers/fixtures. Write only test specifications and related test artifacts, no implementation code.
acceptance_criteria: All EXT-02 acceptance criteria map to explicit test cases
Unit and integration coverage are both specified
Edge cases are explicit, including invalid-JSON 2xx success and per-subscription retry isolation
Traceability matrix links test IDs to requirements and modules
Artifacts are written under tests/specs/ or tests/ as appropriate

result.summary: Created the EXT-02 test specification with explicit unit and integration coverage for webhook subscription APIs, payload/header/signature contract, retry and pause behavior, OBS-06 pause alert trigger, OBS-03 auditing, and required edge cases.
